name: Prone T-Raise

rehabilitation.clinical_protocol: AAOS Rotator Cuff and Shoulder Conditioning Program

steps: Lie face down on a comfortable exercise mat with your legs extended straight behind you.
Extend both arms directly out to your sides at 90 degrees to form the letter 'T', with your thumbs pointed upward toward the ceiling.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together to lift your straight arms 2 to 4 inches off the ground.
Pause at the top for one second, maintaining gentle tension between your shoulder blades.
Lower your arms smoothly back to the floor under control.
coaching_cues: Do not shrug your shoulders toward your ears; keep your traps relaxed and depressed.
Initiate the movement by pinching the shoulder blades, not by flicking your wrists.
Breathe out as you lift and breathe in as you lower.
